prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1072; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with injuries sustained in a recent motor vehicle collision involving your insured. The collision was a head-on impact, and our client has since sought medical treatment for injuries that are ongoing. Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person.

We request that you provide a complete copy of the declarations page for the policy in question, including the bodily injury and property damage liability limits, and confirm whether any additional coverage applies. We also ask that you identify the adjuster assigned to this claim.

Please ensure that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes photographs, vehicle data and event data recorder information, repair and salvage records, witness statements, recorded calls, claim notes, and any electronic communications. Failure to preserve such evidence may result in sanctions. We look forward to your prompt response.
